name: Ameren
description: Ameren is a regulated utility holding company with four reportable segments: Ameren Missouri (integrated electric generation, transmission and distribution plus gas distribution, with the Callaway nuclear plant), Ameren Illinois Electric Distribution, Ameren Illinois Natural Gas, and Ameren Transmission (FERC formula-rate transmission in Illinois and elsewhere). About 87% of 2025 revenue was electric and 13% gas. Its transmission segment earns the highest allowed ROE (10.48%) and produced 28% of earnings from 10% of revenue. Illinois electric distribution revenue is set by an annual reconciliation formula (allowed ROE 8.72% in the current framework), while Ameren Missouri uses historical test-year rate cases and has asked for a 10.25% ROE.

gics.note: Conventional filing label: GICS Sector 'Utilities', Sub-Industry 'Multi-Utilities' per Wikipedia 'List of S&P 500 companies' (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_S%26P_500_companies, read 2026-09-30); that list gives only Sector and Sub-Industry. SEC SIC code 4931 (Electric & Other Services Combined) per EDGAR.

hq.note: EDGAR business address St. Louis, MO

businessLines.name: Ameren Missouri
businessLines.how: Customers pay Missouri PSC-approved electric and gas rates each month; the utility recovers prudent costs and earns a return on rate base, with riders (PISA, fuel adjustment) letting investment and fuel costs flow through between rate cases.
businessLines.description: Union Electric: rate-regulated electric generation, transmission and distribution and natural gas distribution in Missouri; owns the Callaway nuclear energy center (licence to 2044), hydro and pumped storage, wind and solar.

revenue.note: Electric $4,631M plus natural gas $164M (FY2025 10-K segment table)

businessLines.revenueNote: Electric $4,631M plus natural gas $164M (FY2025 10-K segment table)

operatingProfit.note: Segment operating income; net income attributable to common $747M (FY2024 $559M)

businessLines.name: Ameren Illinois Electric Distribution
businessLines.how: Delivery charges set through a multi-year plan with an annual reconciliation of the revenue requirement to actual recoverable costs, so volume risk is small; power supply costs are passed through.
businessLines.description: Illinois electric distribution (power supply is not regulated: customers may choose another supplier but Ameren Illinois is provider of last resort).

operatingProfit.note: Segment operating income; net income attributable to common $281M (FY2024 $234M)

businessLines.name: Ameren Illinois Natural Gas
businessLines.how: Regulated delivery rates with purchased gas adjustment (pass-through) and volume balancing, earning a 9.60% ROE.

revenue.note: Natural gas revenues of the segment

businessLines.revenueNote: Natural gas revenues of the segment

operatingProfit.note: Segment operating income; net income attributable to common $158M (FY2024 $149M)

businessLines.name: Ameren Transmission
businessLines.how: Annual formula rates: revenue requirement is recalculated from expected rate base and the allowed 10.48% ROE, then reconciled to actual costs; paid by MISO-region transmission users.
businessLines.description: Electric transmission of Ameren Illinois and ATXI (Ameren Transmission Company of Illinois) under FERC formula rates.

operatingProfit.note: Segment operating income; net income attributable to common $415M (FY2024 $323M)
